rec.name: Feature Bubbles (Interactive Thumbnail Selector with Content Panel)

what.text: A section that shows a large hero/thumbnail image with a row of circular (or rounded-square) image 'bubbles' beneath it. Each bubble has a short label below it. Clicking a bubble swaps the hero image and the content panel below (a bullet list with icons plus body text) to describe that product, feature or benefit. The active bubble gets a highlighted border and label color, optionally underlined. Each Item block carries its own thumbnail, avatar image, button label and content.

why.text: Visitors pick the benefit or product variant that interests them and see only that content, so the page stays compact and scannable instead of presenting a wall of text. Image-led navigation draws attention and invites interaction, and the active-state highlight shows where they are. Short, benefit-led bullets such as product types, a scent or a guarantee make the value proposition easy to absorb.

how.text: Add the 'CRO | Feature Bubbles' section in the theme editor and create one Item block per bubble. In each Item, upload the thumbnail (hero image) and avatar (bubble image), set the button label, and write the rich-text content (bullets and paragraph). Then set the section-level options: layout style (Boxed or Full-width), colors, spacing, and button styling (size, position, gap, font, shape, border, active colors). Upload high-resolution images, because the client reported blurring from compression. The section uses the Nunito font (replacing the previous MIAMO) for button labels. In Full-width layout, buttons are left-aligned with a 60px gap by default, and content has side padding so text does not touch the edge.

Button text uppercase toggle
Button style: Circle / Rounded
Button text color and active text color
Show border toggle, border size, border color, active border color
Underline active text toggle
Content text color and content position (Left/Center/Right)
Per Item: thumbnail image, thumbnail avatar, button label, button image, rich-text content, per-item button colors

dependencies.text: No apps or metafields are visible. It needs a Shopify OS 2.0 theme with sections and blocks, and the Nunito font loaded in the theme. Colors support dynamic sources (the database icon beside each field). Source images must be high-resolution to avoid blurring.

Add-to-cart rate for sessions that interact
Conversion rate on the page
Bounce rate or time on page
